verdict.rationale: Token2 ships a first-party bulk-enrollment tool that pre-registers FIDO2 keys in Microsoft Entra ID through the FIDO2 Provisioning Graph API, with random PIN setting, key management and result logging. fido2-manage adds per-device audit export to JSON/CSV. Fleet lifecycle tracking of issued keys is only evidenced through enrollment logs and per-device dumps, not a central inventory, and pre-registration is documented only for Entra ID. Missing for 10: a centralized inventory/lifecycle tracking of issued keys across the org, pre-registration beyond Entra ID, detailed docs on bulk configuration scope, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an IT admin, I can provision keys across an organization at scale — pre-registration, bulk configuration, and lifecycle tracking of issued keys

citations.quote: This tool streamlines the process of registering FIDO2 security keys in Microsoft Entra ID by leveraging the FIDO2 Provisioning Graph API. It supports features like setting random PINs, managing keys, and logging results
Automated Registration for Entra ID with PowerShell and GraphAPI
